foils.code:
def transform(grid):
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if any(x!=0 for x in r)]
    cols=[j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[i][j]!=0 for i in range(len(grid)))]
    if not rows or not cols: return [[]]
    w=max(cols)-min(cols)+1
    return [[0]*w]

def transform(grid):
    cols=[j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[i][j]!=0 for i in range(len(grid)))]
    if not cols: return [[]]
